item.title: New Tag Autocomplete Extension for Stable Diffusion AUTOMATIC1111 Web UI
item.description:
New Tag Autocomplete Extension for Stable Diffusion AUTOMATIC1111 Web UI

Tag Autocomplete is an extension for the popular AUTOMATIC1111 web UI for Stable Diffusion that provides suggested tags from image booru boards. It displays autocompletion hints for recognized tags to improve prompt accuracy.

🔍 Overview

The extension displays autocompletion hints for recognized tags from image booru boards such as Danbooru and e621. These tags are primarily used for browsing Anime-style illustrations, but they are relevant to a wide range of Stable Diffusion models.

Feature Description
Danbooru & e621 Tags Top 100k tags by post count as of November 2022
Wildcard Support Works with wildcard files from extensions or scripts
Extra Networks Support for Extra Network previews
UI Modes Dark and Light mode support with specific tag colors

🧩 How it works

Completion is triggered by typing a double underscore (__). The extension searches for wildcard files in every extension folder and the scripts/wildcards folder to support legacy versions. It also supports nested folders for grouped wildcards. Because this was one of the first extensions available, it appears high in the inbuilt extensions list when sorting by “oldest first.”

⚙️ Key details

Users can locate the extension by using CTRL + F to search for text on the extensions page. It is compatible with wildcard files used by the AUTOMATIC1111 wildcards extension and other similar scripts. Completion provides exact tags that match training data for many popular models.

🚀 Availability

Installation is available through three primary methods:

  • Using the inbuilt available extensions list within the web UI.
  • Manual cloning of the extension files from the repository.
  • Downloading pre-packaged versions from the project’s Releases page.

💡 Why it matters

Most custom Stable Diffusion models were trained using booru tag information or merged with models that were. Using exact tags in prompts can improve composition and consistency, even if the model itself is designed for a photorealistic style.

#StableDiffusion #Danbooru #AUTOMATIC1111 #AItools #ImageGeneration

Source: DominikDoom/a1111-sd-webui-tagcomplete

item.title: Sygil.Dev Releases Feature-Rich Stable Diffusion WebUI with Low VRAM Support
item.description:
Sygil.Dev Releases Feature-Rich Stable Diffusion WebUI with Low VRAM Support

Sygil.Dev has released a WebUI that provides an easy way to work with Stable Diffusion directly from a web browser. The application features a clean, widescreen-compatible user interface designed to streamline image generation and editing tasks.

🔍 Overview

The tool offers a complete environment for generating and refining images, featuring a dynamic live preview of generations as they are created and an integrated gallery to show outputs for a prompt. It comes with an automated launcher that activates conda and runs Stable Diffusion with a single command. Users can easily customize their defaults right from the WebUI’s Settings tab.

⚙️ Key details

The WebUI incorporates a wide range of features to optimize performance and give users detailed control over their generations:

  • Resource Management: It is designed to be lighter on VRAM, allowing 512x512 Text2Image and Image2Image tasks to work on 4GB of VRAM with the optimized mode enabled in settings. Users can also select GPU usage from the Settings tab or run additional upscaling models on the CPU to save VRAM.
  • Samplers and Upscalers: It supports a collection of K-Diffusion samplers, including k_euler, k_lms, k_euler_a, k_dpm_2, k_dpm_2_a, k_heun, PLMS, and DDIM. It has access to upscaling models including GFPGAN, realESRGAN, and LSDR.
  • Face and Image Editing: Users can improve faces using the GFPGAN model, either at 100% via a checkbox in every tab or by using a dedicated tab with a strength slider. The Gradio advanced img2img editor supports mask and crop capabilities, including mask painting to re-generate specific parts of an image.
  • Prompt and Seed Control: Features include prompt weighting, negative prompts, and prompt validation with warning messages for overly long prompts. A prompt matrix generates images for every combination of prompts separated by the “|” character. Additionally, users can utilize word seeds instead of seed numbers, sequential seeds for batches, and dynamic prompt entry to change settings based on “–params” in a prompt. Loopback mode automatically feeds the last generated sample back into img2img.
  • Text and Image Extensions: The interface supports training custom embeddings on any photo via Textual Inversion training, running existing custom embeddings via the Concepts Library, and an Image to Text feature powered by the CLIP Interrogator. A Text to Video generation feature is also included as a work-in-progress.

🚀 Availability

Although the older Gradio interface is functional and feature-complete, it is no longer being actively developed by Sygil.Dev and is only receiving bug fixes. However, multiple features are currently in development, including Stable Horde integration, ImgLab, batch inputs, and the Gradio mask editor.

#StableDiffusion #SygilDev #WebUI #GenerativeAI #ComputerVision

Source: Sygil-Dev/sygil-webui

item.title: AI‑Powered CLI Pipeline Generates Custom PDFs for Job Applications
item.description:
AI‑Powered CLI Pipeline Generates Custom PDFs for Job Applications

Um conjunto de agentes de IA (CrewAI + AWS Bedrock/Claude) lê a descrição de uma vaga e a base profissional da pessoa e gera currículos personalizados em PDF/LaTeX, em PT ou EN, sem inventar informações e preservando toda a trajetória de carreira. O autor, profissional de TI com mais de 30 anos de carreira, usou o método e foi contratado 5 meses depois.

🔍 Overview

  • Ferramenta: CLI com agentes de IA que automatiza a parte mais trabalhosa do método, produzindo currículos sob medida para cada vaga.
  • Método: passo a passo que organiza a busca, da construção do perfil às retrospectivas que refinam o processo.
  • Abordagem: tratado como um pipeline de dados, em que cada etapa recebe a saída da anterior.

🧩 How it Works

  • Cria‑se um arquivo profile_truth.md contendo a versão longa e honesta da carreira.
  • Todo currículo e toda resposta de entrevista são gerados a partir desse arquivo.
  • A IA propõe reordenação, resumo e tradução; o usuário decide o que usar.
  • A IA não pode inventar informações; nada sai com o seu nome sem você ler.
  • Uma planilha simples rastreia quais currículos e fontes de vagas geram respostas.
  • Ao fim de cada prazo definido, uma retrospectiva transforma os dados coletados em ajustes no processo.
  • Duas trilhas seguem o mesmo método; a diferença está em quem produz o currículo (prompts em chat de IA vs. CLI que gera os arquivos).

⚙️ Key Details

  • Requisitos de ambiente
    • Assistente de IA
    • Python 3.9+ (ou Python 3.12)
    • LaTeX para gerar PDFs
    • Chave de API de um provedor de IA
  • Segurança
    • Diretórios input/, data/, outputs/ e privado/ estão no .gitignore.
    • Chaves de API ficam somente no .env, que também é ignorado pelo git.
    • Senhas, documentos e dados bancários nunca entram em prompts.
  • Limitações da CLI
    • Cobre apenas parte do método; não busca nem tria vagas.
    • Usa prompts prontos em um chat de IA para gerar o conteúdo.
  • Funções automáticas
    • Revisão de cobertura automática por posição; prompt disponível para identificar lacunas da vaga.
    • Preparação de entrevista com rascunho automático.
  • Avisos
    • A IA pode errar datas, exagerar resultados e trocar números.
    • O projeto não serve para fabricar experiência, burlar triagem ou candidatar‑se em massa sem ler as vagas.
  • Documentação
    • Tutorial completo em meu-emprego-novo-pipeline/README.md.

🚀 Availability

  • O código está organizado em pastas (input/, data/, outputs/, privado/) protegidas por .gitignore.
  • O usuário executa um comando que dispara os agentes e gera os arquivos de currículo.
  • As duas trilhas (uso de prompts vs. CLI) utilizam o mesmo perfil‑mestre escrito em profile_truth.md.

💡 Why it Matters

  • Gera currículos personalizados sem inventar informações, preservando a integridade da carreira.
  • Automatiza a parte mais trabalhosa da preparação de candidatura, permitindo foco na revisão e no ajuste contínuo.
  • Fornece métricas simples (planilha) para avaliar quais abordagens geram respostas, apoiando decisões baseadas em dados.

#AIAgents #ResumeAutomation #CLI #CareerTech

Source: R238Company/meu-emprego-novo

item.title: Taste Skill Update Introduces Agent Design Capabilities and TasteCode Desktop Application
item.description:
Taste Skill Update Introduces Agent Design Capabilities and TasteCode Desktop Application

Taste Skill has released an update to its suite of Agent Skills, enabling coding agents to design custom websites rather than assembling standard landing pages. The update includes the launch of TasteCode, a dedicated desktop application that integrates these design agent capabilities directly into a local environment.

🔍 Overview

Taste Skill provides a framework for AI agents to move beyond simple assembly. It allows agents to generate original designs by providing art direction and sourcing real photography from open archives. The system is designed to allow agents to visually review and verify their own work within a browser.

🧩 How it works

The system utilizes a default skill set that manages the design and verification process:

  • Art Direction: Provides specific visual guidance to the coding agent.
  • Asset Sourcing: Finds and credits real photographs from open archives.
  • Visual Review: Automatically checks UI output in a real browser instance.
  • UI Drafting: The design agent briefs, builds, and reviews user interfaces.

⚙️ Key details

Taste Skill and TasteCode are built to operate with minimal configuration and specific environment requirements.

Feature Specification
Runtime Requirement Node 22+
Browser Compatibility Chrome, Edge, or Chromium
Credentials No API keys required
Connectivity Network access required for image sourcing
License Free and open source

🚀 Availability

Users can integrate Taste Skill through command-line tools or by using the standalone desktop app.

  • CLI Installation: Users can add the full repository using npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill or target the specific design skill with the --skill "design-taste-frontend" flag.
  • TasteCode App: The desktop version is available for download at tastecode.dev and includes the design agent built-in.
  • Open Source: The source code for these tools is available on GitHub.

#AIagents #WebDesign #OpenSource #TasteCode #WebDev

Source: Leonxlnx/taste-skill

item.title: SurfSense Launches as Open-Source Research Platform for AI Agents
item.description:
SurfSense Launches as Open-Source Research Platform for AI Agents

SurfSense has launched as an open-source, self-hostable alternative to NotebookLM, designed specifically as a research platform for AI agents. It provides a framework for agents to perform live web research, turning findings into structured briefs and alerts.

🔍 Overview

SurfSense functions as an agent harness that manages the infrastructure for web research, including retries, structured output, and credit metering. It allows users to go from a question to a cited brief without building custom plumbing.

🧩 How it works

Agents access live data through a single REST API or an MCP server. The platform exposes every connector as a native tool, compatible with Claude, Cursor, and other agent frameworks. It also supports external MCP connectors for integration with services like Notion, Slack, and Jira.

⚙️ Key details

Platform Data Provided
Reddit Posts, comments, subreddit streams
YouTube Videos, transcripts, comment threads
Instagram Public profiles, posts, reels
TikTok Videos, comments, hashtags, profiles
Google Maps Places, ratings, reviews
Google Search Live SERPs
Indeed Public job postings, salaries, descriptions
Amazon Prices, ratings, offers, sellers, best-seller ranks
Walmart Product data, full review history, prices, variants
Web Crawl Clean, structured content from any web page

🚀 Availability

SurfSense is available as an open-source and self-hosted solution. The platform includes a built-in knowledge base that keeps findings searchable with citations, supporting features such as chat, reports, podcasts, presentations, and automations.

#AI #OpenSource #Research #WebAutomation

Source: MODSetter/SurfSense

item.title: Memanto introduces autonomous memory management for AI agent fleets
item.description:
Memanto introduces autonomous memory management for AI agent fleets

Memanto, a companion Memory Agent, runs alongside a fleet of AI agents to manage their memories automatically.

🔍 Overview

  • A second agent that runs beside your fleet and performs six autonomous actions.
  • No library calls, no wrapper, no code changes required.
  • Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.

🧩 How it works

  • Stream watching – Memanto watches the interaction streams of the agents it serves and pulls durable knowledge out of ephemeral traffic (decisions, preferences, facts, failures).
  • Canonical estate – Extracted memories are merged into one canonical estate where duplicates collapse, fragments join, and repeated observations strengthen confidence.
  • Contradiction handling – When new knowledge contradicts old, Memanto supersedes the old entry while preserving the prior belief and its timestamp.
  • Managed forgetting – Decay, expiry, and deliberate deletion are policies Memanto executes, preventing the estate from becoming noisy.
  • Pre‑action briefing – Before an agent acts, Memanto hands it the minimal relevant slice of the estate.
  • Cross‑framework sharing – Through the Open Knowledge Format the estate crosses frameworks and vendors, letting agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and custom stacks share one memory instead of five silos.
  • Daily loop – Each day new memories are curated, duplicates merged across agents, and contradictions flagged for review.

⚙️ Key details

  • Features

    • Runs as a separate agent alongside your fleet.
    • Watches interaction streams and extracts durable knowledge.
    • Merges memories into a single estate, collapsing duplicates and joining fragments.
    • Supersedes contradictory knowledge while preserving history.
    • Executes decay, expiry, and deletion policies automatically.
    • Provides a minimal relevant memory slice to agents before they act.
    • Shares the estate across different frameworks via the Open Knowledge Format.
    • Daily curation loop with duplicate merging and contradiction flagging.
    • Local UI dashboard (memanto ui) to browse, search, and audit the estate.
    • Exportable estate as plain Markdown (memanto memory export --okf).
    • Migration support for Mem0, Letta, Supermemory, or any OKF bundle.
    • No code changes, no wrapper, no rewrite of the agent loop.
    • Available on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

  • Command reference

    Command Purpose
    memanto connect <agent> Connects Memanto to an agent (e.g., claude-code, cursor, codex, windsurf, cline, goose, copilot)
    memanto recall "deployment policy" --as-of 2026-08-05 Retrieves a memory snapshot as of a specific date
    memanto recall "deployment policy" --changed-since v2.1 Retrieves changes since a given version
    memanto ui Opens a local dashboard to browse, search, and audit the whole estate
    memanto memory export --okf Exports the estate in Open Knowledge Format (plain Markdown, readable, diffable, committable, greppable)
    memanto migrate Imports from or exports to Mem0, Letta, Supermemory, or any OKF bundle

🚀 Availability

  • Install with pip install memanto.
  • Runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

💡 Why it matters

  • Agents share one managed memory estate, eliminating siloed silos.
  • Managed forgetting keeps recall sharp even after a year of operation.
  • Daily automated curation means the fleet knows more than it did yesterday without manual sorting.
  • The Open Knowledge Format makes the estate portable, version‑controlled, and human‑readable.

#AIAgents #MemoryManagement #OpenKnowledgeFormat

Source: moorcheh-ai/memanto
